newsitem.title: USA: Benton Oil completes purchase of Crestone.
newsitem.headline: Benton Oil completes purchase of Crestone.

text.p: Benton Oil & Gas Co on Thursday completed its purchase of Crestone Energy Corp, a privately held firm based in Denver, Colorado.
Benton said the merger is valued at $15.5 million.

Crestone's primary asset is a petroleum contract with the China National Offshore Oil Corporation, the company said. The contract gives Crestone the right to explore and develop 6.2 million acres in in an area of the South China Sea known as Wan'An Bei, WAB-21.
The Carpinteria-based company will issue one share of common stock in exchange for each seven outstanding shares of Crestone's, resulting in the issuance of about 735,700 shares of Benton stock.
